breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still combines both conflicting instructions: it specifies a 'gamma-centered Monkhorst-Pack grid' while simultaneously applying a half shift (1 1 1), which is contradictory. The ground truth removes the half-shift instruction entirely, leaving only the gamma-centered grid. The agent failed to resolve this inconsistency and instead repeated the error by including both conflicting elements.
